机制概述: Dareios has 5 Drink Cards that give him both a bonus and a penalty. They remain active until they leave his Discard Piles and then are gone for good, so careful use of his intoxicants is key.

效果.效果: Drinks: Drinks remain active and apply to attacks even while in the Discard Piles.
Recycle: Trash any Drinks in Discard Pile 2. Put any Drinks in Discard Pile 1 into Discard Pile 2. Put any active Drinks into Discard Pile 1.
